description: Source-reviewed repeated questions. Only status reviewed pairs fold; rejected former matches remain in the audit trail. Problem-pattern relationships are separate.

kinds.same: The same question asked again; wording, option order or format may differ.
kinds.numbers: The same setup and the same question, with only the given values changed.

coverage: Not exhaustive. All 28 legacy pairs were source-reviewed:19 retained as repeats,9 rejected as pattern-only. Three additional numbers pairs were source-reviewed. Discovery can miss differently worded, diagram-dependent and incompletely transcribed questions.
